description: Search 130,000+ official recalls from 5 government sources in one call: US FDA (food, drugs, medical devices), CPSC (consumer products), NHTSA (vehicles), Health Canada (incl. CFIA food, Transport Canada) and UK Food Standards Agency (allergy alerts). One normalized row: product, brand, reason, hazard, class, date, remedy, official link. Filter by words, brand, vehicle make/model/year, country, category, class, date. Index refreshed every 6 h, answers < 1 s. Free: 5 calls/day per IP. Paid: Radar API key (from €15/mo at https://radarbg.com/pricing#starter via X-API-Key) or $0.002/call via x402 at https://radarbg.com/x402/product-recalls.

brand.description: Brand or recalling company, e.g. Tesco, Olymel

category.description: food, drug, medical_device, consumer_product, vehicle or cosmetic (comma list)

classification.description: I, II, III (most serious = I) or a UK alert type like allergy alert

country.description: US, CA or UK (comma list; empty = all)

mode.description: search or sources (freshness of each source)

query.description: Words that must appear: product, ingredient, hazard, lot or model, e.g. peanut, listeria

since.description: Only recalls on or after YYYY-MM-DD

sinceDays.description: Only recalls from the last N days

source.description: fda, cpsc, nhtsa, health_canada or uk_fsa (comma list)

until.description: Only recalls on or before YYYY-MM-DD

name: product_recalls
title: Product Recalls API - FDA, CPSC, Vehicle, Canada, UK
